LightningComponentBundle.description: Embeds the Egnyte Visualforce page in an iframe for LWR Experience sites (VF-in-LWC workaround).

property.name: domain
property.label: Domain
property.description: Published Experience site domain for the Egnyte Visualforce iframe.

property.name: cardTitle
property.label: Card Title
property.description: Heading above the Egnyte panel. Leave blank for no heading.

property.name: frameHeight
property.label: Panel Height (px)
property.description: How tall the Egnyte panel is. The Egnyte canvas app inside is fixed at 600px and scrolls, so raise this once the file browser is what users see.
